title: fanoutqa: Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA? (0d90e4035372e84d)

chat_history.content: Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?

content.content:
The user asks: "Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?" We need to interpret: top 5 scorers in the NBA - likely all-time scoring leaders? Or top 5 scorers currently? Usually "top 5 scorers in the NBA" could refer to the all-time points leaders. Those are: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (now LeBron), LeBron James, Karl Malone, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, etc. Actually top 5 all-time scoring list (as of 2025) includes LeBron, Kareem, Karl, Kobe, Michael Jordan. Among those, who has the most MVP awards? Let's recall:

- LeBron James: 4 MVPs (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013)
- Kareem Abdul-Jabbar: 6 MVPs (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980)
- Karl Malone: 0 MVP (he was runner-up many times)
- Kobe Bryant: 1 MVP (2008)
- Michael Jordan: 5 MVPs (1988, 1991, 1992, 1996, 1998)

Thus Kareem has most with 6. So answer: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

But we need to confirm top 5 scorers list. As of 2025, LeBron likely passed Kareem. So top 5: LeBron, Kareem, Karl, Kobe, Michael. So answer: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar with six MVPs.

We could also mention that if considering active top 5 scorers (current season), they'd be: LeBron, Durant, Giannis, etc. But the phrasing likely all-time. Provide answer.

| Player (All‑time top‑5 scorer) | Career Points (approx.) | MVP Awards |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------|------------|
| **LeBron James**              | 38,500+ (still active)   | 4 (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) |
| **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar**       | 38,387 (all‑time leader) | **6** (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980) |
| **Karl Malone**               | 36,928                   | 0 |
| **Kobe Bryant**               | 33,643                   | 1 (2008) |
| **Michael Jordan**            | 32,292                   | 5 (1988, 1991, 1992, 1996, 1998) |

Kareem’s six MVP trophies (the most in NBA history) out‑shine the totals of the other four members of the top‑5 scoring list.
